prompt: Built-in imagegen: square 3x3 swatch of crude prehistoric finds on warm ivory paper, matte gouache and dry brush. Cells in order: ember-shading stone, widened hide strip, backward snapped point, scorched clay ball, root-hung sound stone, raised bark tray, leaf-guarded stone flake, shell in branch grip, twig across opening.

entries.review: Top-left: rough flat stone shading a small ember over dust, with no constructed hearth.
Top-middle: ragged untanned hide strip broadening at one end, with crude natural-fiber tie.

entries.issue: The point appears conventionally hafted and effective rather than snapped and fitted backward.

entries.review: Middle-left: cracked fire-scorched clay ball with raw inner clay exposed; no fired vessel.

entries.issue: The hanging stone appears pierced, suggesting a manufactured fitting absent from the find.

entries.review: Middle-right: folded ragged bark makes a rough tray with a naturally raised corner.
Bottom-left: chipped stone flake protected by a loose fold of broad leaves.
Bottom-middle: large jagged shell pressed against a naturally forked branch as a crude grip.
Bottom-right: unmarked thin twig laid across a narrow gap between rough stones.
